mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RECEIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS receiptCount , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ASSIGNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS assignedCount , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS progressCount , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completeCount FROM AS_REQUEST

SELECT REQUEST_NO , CUSTOMER_NAME , SYMPTOM , SUBSTRING_INDEX(CUSTOMER_ADDR, ' ', 2) AS REGION , STATUS , DATE_FORMAT(REQUEST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REQUEST_DATE FROM AS_REQUEST ORDER BY REQUEST_DATE DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT REQUEST_NO , CUSTOMER_NAME , CUSTOMER_TEL , CUSTOMER_ADDR , PRODUCT_TYPE , SYMPTOM , DATE_FORMAT(REQUEST_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REQUEST_DATE , DATE_FORMAT(WISH_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS WISH_DATE , STATUS FROM AS_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_NO = #{requestNo}
